title: Verify European conditional packed lookup CLI
changes: Record production CLI creation, reuse and startup with the EUR e97-d96 packed lookup dataset.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine create/reuse/startup sequence passed: 88 files match the accepted dataset, 87 runtime identities match, and managed files and guarded inputs remain unchanged.
limitations: Ordinary lookup use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no performance measurements.
